metadata.title: When you click like a potato and Valorant says ‘Here’s your 1 kill, mystery player’
metadata.description:
Clicked without aiming and boom, one kill out of nowhere.
Enemy probably uninstalling to question reality.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies for no reason.
Click if you’ve ever got a kill you did NOT earn!

Tap if your best kill was pure luck!

#valorant #luckykill #funnygaming #gamingfails #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
